answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 10865 Country: India Title: assalamoalekum i want to name my new born son muhammad zayan. Is it good Question: assalamoalekum i want to name my new born son muhammad zayan. Is it good Answer ID: 10865 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 238/213=D/1430) Zayan means: beautiful, it is correct to keep this name. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
